style.vernacular: French-Pacific colonial capital on a peninsula: low and mid-rise rendered concrete buildings in white and pastel tones with flat or low-pitched roofs, a few surviving timber colonial villas with verandas and hipped corrugated-iron roofs painted red or green, 1960s-80s concrete apartment blocks, and Kanak grande-case motifs (conical thatched roof, carved door posts) at cultural sites. Palms, flamboyant trees and niaouli. Wall and roof colours are estimates from general knowledge of the city: no retrievable source gave a colour palette.
style.ornament: Colonial timber verandas with fretwork and shuttered windows; louvred concrete screens and brise-soleil on 1970s buildings; Kanak carved flèche faîtière roof finials and thatched conical grande cases at cultural sites; bright bougainvillea and flamboyant trees.

sources.what: city overview: centre built on fill/polders, Place des Cocotiers with fountain and kiosk, WWII US demi-lunes; the architecture section was not retrievable so colours are estimated
airport history: 1970s terminal replaced by a new terminal in 2001
